subject: biochemistry
title: Water-soluble vitamins: key coenzymes and deficiency syndromes

steps.tx: Water-soluble vitamins are mostly **coenzymes** or their precursors. They are not stored in large amounts, so deficiency can appear within weeks when intake falls. The B complex and vitamin C form this group. Learn each vitamin with its active form, its reaction type and its classic deficiency disease.
steps.say: Water-soluble vitamins mostly act as coenzymes. They are not stored in large amounts, so deficiency can appear within weeks when intake falls. The B complex and vitamin C form this group. Learn each vitamin with its active form, its reaction type and its classic deficiency disease.

steps.tx: Thiamine (B1) becomes **thiamine pyrophosphate** and works in pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and transketolase. Wernicke encephalopathy, with ophthalmoplegia, nystagmus and ataxia, reflects thiamine lack in chronic alcoholics. Transketolase activity before and after adding TPP is the lab test, with over 25 percent stimulation read as deficiency.
steps.say: Thiamine becomes thiamine pyrophosphate and works in pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and transketolase. Wernicke encephalopathy, with ophthalmoplegia, nystagmus and ataxia, reflects thiamine lack, typically in chronic alcoholics. The laboratory test measures transketolase activity before and after adding thiamine pyrophosphate, and more than 25 percent stimulation is read as deficiency.

steps.tx: Niacin deficiency causes **pellagra**, classically the three Ds: dermatitis, diarrhoea and dementia. Maize and sorghum diets are poor in niacin and tryptophan, and excess leucine blocks tryptophan conversion. Carcinoid syndrome and Hartnup disease also cause it, because tryptophan is diverted or poorly absorbed.

steps.tx: Vitamin B12 is a cofactor for **methylmalonyl CoA mutase** and for **methionine synthase**. Its deficiency causes pernicious anaemia, a megaloblastic anaemia with spinal cord degeneration. Folate deficiency gives megaloblastic anaemia without neurological change. Vitamin B12 is found only in animal foods, so strict vegetarians are at risk.

steps.tx: Folate, as **tetrahydrofolate**, carries one-carbon units for thymidylate, purine and methionine synthesis. Methotrexate blocks dihydrofolate reductase, so the body becomes functionally folate deficient. Raw egg white contains avidin, which binds **biotin**, and cooking denatures it. Biotin is a cofactor for carboxylases such as acetyl CoA carboxylase.

steps.tx: Riboflavin (vitamin B2) is converted into **FMN** and **FAD**, which act as coenzymes for flavoprotein redox reactions. Deficiency produces angular cheilosis, glossitis and corneal vascularisation. Pantothenic acid is the precursor of **coenzyme A**, essential for fatty acid metabolism and the citric acid cycle. Deficiency is rare, so its features are seldom seen outside severe malnutrition.
